request.description: Asks for a message when an analysis completes (`analysis.completed`, one message) or an application changes status (`application.status_changed`, every change). `push` falls back to SMS when the user has no device; `whatsapp` is refused until a WhatsApp provider is configured. Borrower and partner contexts; only for records the caller can see.
